Collision |pvp_ranged_damage = [[File:OffensiveModifier.png|20px|Damage]]20 |pvp_ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.8 |pvp_ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]6 |pvp_speed = 3.5 |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |pvp_flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Sword Skeleton''' is a unit spawned from the [[Necromancer]]'s gravestones and randomly from dead enemies while the [[Necromancer's Tome (Consumable)|Necromancer's Tome]] consumable is active. It can spawn from Level 1 gravestones, though only if the [[Necromancer]] is at Level 1 or higher. If there are enemies in its range, it will stop moving and start attacking them with its sword. If there are no enemies in its range, it will wait for a while for enemies to enter it. If no enemy enters its range, it will continue walking. It can also deal damage through collision. ==Appearance== The '''Sword Skeleton''' is made entirely of white parts that resemble a skeletal humanoid. It does not have a full torso, but instead has the bone cage for it. Its head is slightly smaller than most other enemies and has two large black eyeholes. It wields a black sword with skulls that have neon blue eyes. ==Skins== {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:MageSwordSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:FallenSwordSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:DuckSwordSkeleton.png|175px]] |[[File:CreepySantaSwordSkeleton.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|Deluxe|Mage}} |{{Color|FallenMission|Fallen}} |{{Color|DuckyRevenge|Duck}} |{{Color|FinalAct|Creepy Santa}} |- !Obtained From |[[Deluxe Crate]] |[[Mission Quests]] |[[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Premium Battle Pass]] |[[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Regular Battle Pass]] |} ==Strategy== *The '''Sword Skeleton''' is similar in terms of health to the [[Skeleton (Unit)|Skeleton]] unit. However, as it has a sword, it can attack enemies, allowing it to survive for longer and deal more damage. **This makes it useful against slower enemies like the [[Abnormal Boss]], [[Normal Boss]] or [[Heavy]]. **However, its low range will makes it weak against fast enemies with high health, like the [[Shock]] or [[Glitch]]. *The '''Sword Skeleton''' can be useful against hidden enemies as it has hidden detection, though it may struggle against higher health hidden enemies like the [[Shadow Boss]]. *The '''Sword Skeleton''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Abnormal Boss]]. **The damage from its sword is still affected by defense. *The '''Sword Skeleton''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and a '''Skeleton''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''31 October 2023''' -
